summary: The note surveys ten street food competitions held between September 2023 and June 2024 in cities around the world, from Singapore and Mumbai to Istanbul. Each event centered on a signature local dish, such as Bhel Puri, kimchi, Pad Thai, tacos, Pastel de Nata, Currywurst, beignets and kebabs. It argues that these contests show tradition and innovation can coexist and celebrate culture, community and regional cuisine.
one_line: A tour of ten street food competitions in 2023-2024 across global cities, showing how local dishes, culture and competition combine.
key_facts: Singapore's "Hawker Chan Showdown" took place on September 15, 2023, with vendors competing to create a dish to rival Hawker Chan's Michelin-starred soy sauce chicken rice.
"The Great Mumbai Bhel-Off" was held on October 3, 2023, with vendors competing with Bhel Puri for the title of Bhel King or Queen; Chef Anjali Pathak was head judge.
The "Seoul Kimchi Wars" on November 22, 2023, had contestants battle to prepare the best kimchi and educated attendees on regional kimchi variations, with a tasting event built in.
"New York's Melting Pot Cook-Off" on December 8, 2023, featured dishes from many cultural backgrounds, including halal gyros and Dominican empanadas.

Bangkok's "Pad Thai Prizefight" on January 28, 2024, had street chefs experiment with local ingredients; the winner received a cash prize and a feature in the guide "Bangkok Bites" by critic Somsak Chuang.
Mexico City's "Ultimate Taco Takedown" on February 18, 2024, featured everything from traditional pastor to modern fusion tacos; Carlos Fuentes documented it on his blog "Taco Times."
Porto's "Pastel de Nata Challenge" on March 20, 2024, had competitors bake custard tarts to impress judge Chef Helena Loureiro.
Berlin's "Currywurst Clash" on April 5, 2024, had butchers and connoisseurs present sausages with secret sauces, and crowds voted for the best Currywurst in town.
The "Baton Rouge Beignet Brawl" on May 11, 2024, in Louisiana featured fried dough dusted with powdered sugar and was judged by beignet connoisseur Celeste Dupree.
The "Istanbul Kebab Klash" on June 7, 2024, saw chefs from across Turkey show mastery in marinating and grilling, with intricately presented final dishes.
The note concludes that these events show tradition and innovation can coexist in street food.
